source: attempt 5 contextual states plus new development targets and controls
reason: A constraint on the mean of several keys does not impose the same correction on each key. Use every distinct native context, with context-specific readout geometry, then protect original post-unit continuations and all observed controls.
formula: Q=principal row space of preservation states C; Z=K-KQQt; deltaW=Vt*pinv(Z)t. Each V is the target readout direction orthogonal to the 128 current leading competitors, scaled to close the original logit gap plus four RMS logit units.
precision: BF16 rounded values before free generation
